/* --- Revision overrides --- */
.brand{min-width:300px;gap:14px}
.brand img.brand-logo{width:52px;height:52px;object-fit:contain;border-radius:50%;background:#fff;padding:2px;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px #db1f29}
.brand-text strong{font-size:18px;letter-spacing:.02em;text-transform:uppercase}
.brand-text span{font-size:11px;color:#d0d4dc;letter-spacing:.12em}
.page-hero{padding:58px 0 52px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#0e1014 0%,#101218 100%);border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.page-hero .crumb{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;color:#8d94a0;font-size:13px;margin-bottom:14px}
.page-hero .crumb a{color:#c7ccd4;text-decoration:none;padding:6px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);transition:.2s}
.page-hero .crumb a:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#fff}
.page-hero .crumb .sep{opacity:.45}
.org-banner{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#08090c,#10131a);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-radius:30px;padding:26px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.org-banner img{width:min(100%,860px);display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.4))}
.value-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px}
.value-card{border-radius:28px;padding:28px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#ffffff,#f3efeb);color:#13151a;border:1px solid #e9e1da;box-shadow:0 16px 30px rgba(11,12,14,.08);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.value-card:before{content:'';position:absolute;right:-30px;top:-30px;width:120px;height:120px;border-radius:50%;background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(226,37,45,.16),transparent 68%)}
.value-card .num{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:14px;background:#111318;color:#fff;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:18px}
.value-card h3{font-size:24px;margin:0 0 10px}
.value-card p{font-size:15px;color:#59616b;margin:0}
.value-card strong{display:block;font-size:16px;color:#20242a;margin-bottom:6px}
.profile-hero.motion-layout{align-items:stretch;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:28px}
.profile-art.motion-card{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#121620,#0b0d12);border-radius:34px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);padding:24px;min-height:560px;overflow:hidden;position:relative}
.profile-art.motion-card:before{content:'FLOW';position:absolute;left:24px;bottom:-18px;font-size:110px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.08em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.04)}
.profile-art.motion-card img{width:100%;max-width:520px;height:auto;display:block;filter:drop-shadow(0 20px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.35))}
.motion-points{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
.motion-points div{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);color:#dbe0e8}
.leader-grid.revised{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(5,1fr);gap:16px}
.leader-card.revised{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#16191f;border:1px solid #2a2f37;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;min-height:360px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.leader-card.revised img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;background:#fff}
.leader-card.revised .copy{padding:18px 18px 22px}
.leader-card.revised .copy h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:22px}
.leader-card.revised .copy p{margin:0;color:#adb3bc;font-size:14px}
.live-photo-note.revised{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:22px;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:20px;background:#14171d;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}
.shop-hero{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.08fr .92fr;gap:24px;align-items:stretch;border-radius:34px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(125deg,#120f12 0%,#b11822 45%,#0f131a 100%);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.shop-hero-copy{padding:42px}
.shop-hero-copy h1{font-size:clamp(44px,6vw,82px);line-height:.9;letter-spacing:-.06em;margin:14px 0 16px}
.shop-hero-copy p{color:#f4dfe2;max-width:620px}
.shop-hero-art{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:24px;position:relative;background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 30%,rgba(255,255,255,.16),transparent 28%),linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(0,0,0,.04),rgba(0,0,0,.28))}
.shop-hero-art img{width:100%;max-width:480px;height:auto;border-radius:26px;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 18px 35px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.categories{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
.cat{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:14px;padding:18px 18px;border-radius:22px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2a2e36;color:#fff}
.cat i{width:42px;height:42px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:rgba(255,255,255,.06);border-radius:14px;font-style:normal}
.shop-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:18px 0 28px}
.filter-pills{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.filter-pills span{padding:9px 14px;border-radius:999px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2b3038;color:#d5dae2;font-size:13px;font-weight:700}
.product-grid.enhanced{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px}
.product.enhanced{display:flex;flex-direction:column;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2a2f37;border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;min-height:390px;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.product.enhanced .product-image{height:220px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#f7f7f7,#e9ecef);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px}
.product.enhanced .product-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;border-radius:16px}
.product.enhanced .product-copy{padding:18px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.product.enhanced .tag{display:inline-flex;width:max-content;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(226,37,45,.14);color:#ff7379;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;text-transform:uppercase}
.product.enhanced h3{margin:0;font-size:22px}
.product.enhanced p{margin:0;color:#adb3bc;font-size:14px;min-height:40px}
.product.enhanced .price{font-size:22px;font-weight:900;color:#fff;margin-top:auto}
.product.enhanced .actions{display:flex;gap:10px;margin-top:10px}
.product.enhanced .actions a,.product.enhanced .actions button{flex:1}
.product-layout.revised{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.95fr 1.05fr;gap:28px;align-items:start}
.product-main-image.revised{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border-radius:32px;padding:18px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#161a20,#0f1217);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);min-height:560px}
.product-main-image.revised img{width:100%;max-width:560px;border-radius:22px;object-fit:cover;box-shadow:0 18px 30px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
.choice-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:16px;margin:20px 0}
.helper-list{display:grid;gap:12px;margin-top:16px}
.helper-list div{padding:14px 16px;border-radius:18px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2a2e36;color:#cbd1da}
.checkout-grid .cart-table.empty-note{display:grid;place-items:center;min-height:280px;text-align:center;padding:28px}
.summary-row small{display:block;color:#8f97a3;margin-top:4px}
@media (max-width:1180px){.leader-grid.revised{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.product-grid.enhanced{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.value-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:980px){.shop-hero,.profile-hero.motion-layout,.product-layout.revised{grid-template-columns:1fr}.categories{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.product-grid.enhanced{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.leader-grid.revised{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media (max-width:700px){.value-grid,.product-grid.enhanced,.categories,.leader-grid.revised{grid-template-columns:1fr}.motion-points,.choice-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.org-banner{padding:18px;border-radius:24px}.brand{min-width:auto}}


/* V3 interaction and content refinements */
.crumb{display:none!important}
.header-inner{height:82px}
.brand-v3{display:flex;align-items:center;min-width:310px;max-width:360px}
.brand-v3 .logo-full{display:block;width:100%;height:54px;object-fit:contain;object-position:left center}
.brand-v3 .logo-crest{display:none;width:50px;height:50px;object-fit:contain}
.footer .brand-v3{max-width:390px}
.footer .brand-v3 .logo-full{height:64px}
.page-hero{padding-top:60px}
.click-grow,a.program-card,a.content-card,a.cat,a.leader-card,a.news-card,a.school-row,a.event-card,.policy-index a,.all-page-card{transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,border-color .22s ease}
a.program-card:hover,a.content-card:hover,a.cat:hover,a.leader-card:hover,a.news-card:hover,a.school-row:hover,a.event-card:hover,.policy-index a:hover,.all-page-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.025);box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.28);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2)}
.animal-grid .animal{transition:transform .22s ease,border-color .22s ease}
.animal-grid .animal:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.025);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.18)}
.crane-photo{height:100px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:10px}
.crane-photo img{height:100px;width:auto;mix-blend-mode:screen;filter:invert(1) grayscale(1) brightness(1.35);object-fit:contain}
.leader-grid-v3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.leader-card-v3{background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2c3139;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden;display:block}
.leader-card-v3 img{display:block;width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;background:#fff}
.leader-card-v3 .leader-copy{padding:20px}
.leader-card-v3 h3{font-size:24px;margin:4px 0 6px}.leader-card-v3 p{color:#aeb4be;margin:0;font-size:14px}
.founder-real{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.82fr 1.18fr;gap:28px;align-items:stretch}
.founder-photo{min-height:620px;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;background:#11151b;border:1px solid #2b3038}
.founder-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.founder-copy{padding:40px;border-radius:32px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2c3139}
.founder-copy h2{font-size:clamp(42px,5vw,70px);line-height:.98;margin:12px 0 18px}
.video-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:18px}
.video-card{background:#15181d;border:1px solid #2b3038;border-radius:26px;overflow:hidden}
.video-card iframe{width:100%;aspect-ratio:16/9;border:0;display:block;background:#000}
.video-card .video-copy{padding:18px}.video-card h3{margin:0 0 6px;font-size:21px}.video-card p{margin:0;color:#aab1bb;font-size:14px}
.product-tile{isolation:isolate;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between}
.product-tile:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,9,12,.16) 0%,rgba(7,9,12,.36) 38%,rgba(7,9,12,.94) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,9,12,.54),rgba(7,9,12,.06)),var(--tilebg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:1;z-index:0}
.product-tile > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
.product-tile b{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:-.025em;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.product-tile .price{position:relative;left:auto;bottom:auto;margin-top:auto;color:#eef2f6;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
.product-tile .product-art{display:none}
.video-card{display:flex;flex-direction:column}
.video-card .video-thumb{position:relative;display:block;aspect-ratio:16/9;background:#0e1116;overflow:hidden}
.video-card .video-thumb:before{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,13,.12) 0%,rgba(8,10,13,.30) 42%,rgba(8,10,13,.84) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,10,13,.50),rgba(8,10,13,.12)),var(--videobg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;transform:scale(1.02)}
.video-card .video-thumb > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
.video-card .video-topbar{display:flex;justify-content:flex-end;padding:16px}
.video-card .video-platform{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(10,12,16,.56);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.10);color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;letter-spacing:.02em;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.video-card .video-play{position:absolute;left:24px;bottom:22px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:15px;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.video-card .video-play .play-icon{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:50%;background:rgba(226,37,45,.92);box-shadow:0 10px 24px rgba(226,37,45,.28);display:grid;place-items:center}
.video-card .video-play .play-icon:before{content:'';width:0;height:0;border-top:9px solid transparent;border-bottom:9px solid transparent;border-left:14px solid #fff;margin-left:3px}
.video-card .video-copy{padding:18px 20px 22px}

.shop-categories-v3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
.shop-categories-v3 .cat{min-height:160px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;justify-content:space-between}
.shop-categories-v3 .cat i{font-size:29px}
.shop-category-active{border-color:#e2252d!important;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px #e2252d}
.product-grid-v3{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:18px}
.real-product-card{background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2c3139;border-radius:25px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;min-height:430px;transition:transform .22s ease,border-color .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease}
.real-product-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.018);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2);box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.real-product-image{height:250px;background:#f5f5f3;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:15px;overflow:hidden}
.real-product-image img{max-width:100%;max-height:100%;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;display:block}
.real-product-image .image-unavailable{color:#454b54;text-align:center;padding:25px;font-size:13px;line-height:1.4}
.real-product-copy{padding:19px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;flex:1}
.real-product-copy .tag{display:inline-flex;width:max-content;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(226,37,45,.14);color:#ff6e75;padding:6px 10px;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.11em;text-transform:uppercase}
.real-product-copy h3{font-size:20px;line-height:1.08;margin:0}.real-product-copy p{font-size:14px;color:#acb2bc;margin:0}.real-product-copy .price{font-size:23px;font-weight:900;margin-top:auto}
.real-product-actions{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:9px;margin-top:4px}.real-product-actions .btn{padding:0 10px}
.empty-shop{padding:48px;border-radius:26px;border:1px dashed #39404b;text-align:center;color:#b7bdc6;background:#14171b}
.product-real-layout{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .9fr;gap:32px;align-items:start}
.product-real-image{min-height:590px;background:#f4f4f1;border-radius:30px;padding:26px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
.product-real-image img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:540px;object-fit:contain}
.product-source{font-size:12px;color:#848c98;margin-top:10px}
.membership-fields{display:grid;gap:12px;margin:18px 0}.membership-fields input,.membership-fields select{width:100%}
.site-index{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:15px}.all-page-card{padding:22px;border-radius:22px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2c3139;display:block}.all-page-card h3{margin:8px 0 4px}.all-page-card span{color:#9fa6b1;font-size:13px}
@media(max-width:1100px){.leader-grid-v3,.video-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.product-grid-v3{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}.site-index{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:900px){.founder-real,.product-real-layout{grid-template-columns:1fr}.founder-photo{min-height:500px}.shop-categories-v3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.product-grid-v3{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.brand-v3{min-width:250px}.nav{gap:13px}}
@media(max-width:680px){.brand-v3{min-width:auto;width:52px}.brand-v3 .logo-full{display:none}.brand-v3 .logo-crest{display:block}.footer .brand-v3{width:100%;max-width:310px}.footer .brand-v3 .logo-full{display:block;width:100%;height:55px}.footer .brand-v3 .logo-crest{display:none}.leader-grid-v3,.video-grid,.product-grid-v3,.site-index,.shop-categories-v3{grid-template-columns:1fr}.founder-photo{min-height:420px}.founder-copy{padding:28px}.real-product-image{height:280px}.product-real-image{min-height:400px}.all-page-card:hover,a.program-card:hover,a.content-card:hover,a.cat:hover,a.leader-card:hover,a.news-card:hover{transform:none}}


.crumb{display:none!important}

.school-row,.policy-index a,.value-card{transition:transform .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}.school-row:hover,.policy-index a:hover,.value-card:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.015);box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}

/* V5 school finder + app */
.find-image{min-height:350px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#0b0d11}
.find-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;position:absolute;inset:0}
.find-image:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(17,19,24,.35),rgba(10,11,14,.06)),linear-gradient(0deg,rgba(0,0,0,.3),transparent 45%)}
.school-toolbar-v5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(260px,2fr) 1fr 1fr auto;gap:12px;padding:18px;border:1px solid #2d3239;border-radius:24px;background:#15181d;margin-bottom:24px}
.school-toolbar-v5 .field{width:100%}
.school-meta{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:8px}
.school-meta .pill{font-size:10px;padding:6px 9px}
.school-results-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;align-items:center;margin:8px 0 16px}
.school-results-head p{margin:0;color:#9da4ae}
.school-row-v5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.25fr 1.1fr .65fr auto;gap:20px;align-items:center;padding:20px 24px;border:1px solid #2d3239;background:#15181d;border-radius:22px;transition:transform .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,background .18s ease}
.school-row-v5 h3{margin:0 0 4px;font-size:20px}
.school-row-v5 .address{color:#9fa6b0;font-size:13px}
.school-row-v5 .programmes{color:#c2c8d1;font-size:14px}
.school-list-v5{display:grid;gap:12px}
.school-empty{padding:44px;border:1px dashed #3b414b;border-radius:24px;text-align:center;color:#aeb4be}
.school-detail-map{border-radius:28px;min-height:320px;background:linear-gradient(135deg,#1e232b,#0b0d10);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:30px;border:1px solid #2b3037}
.school-detail-map strong{display:block;font-size:24px;margin-bottom:8px}
.app-promo{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr .72fr;gap:26px;align-items:center;border-radius:32px;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(140deg,#16191e,#0c0e12);border:1px solid #2d3239}
.app-promo-copy{padding:38px}
.app-promo-copy h2{font-size:clamp(38px,5vw,60px);line-height:.95;letter-spacing:-.05em;margin:12px 0}
.app-promo-copy p{color:#aeb4be;max-width:620px}
.app-buttons{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:24px}
.app-visual{min-height:390px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:28px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 45%,rgba(255,166,0,.16),transparent 38%)}
.app-visual img{max-height:340px;max-width:100%;border-radius:30px;box-shadow:0 24px 50px rgba(0,0,0,.35)}
.app-features{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:12px;margin-top:22px}
.app-feature{padding:14px;border-radius:17px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.05);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:13px;color:#d3d8df}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .school-row-v5:hover{transform:translateY(-3px) scale(1.006);border-color:#444b57;background:#191d23}
}
@media(max-width:980px){
 .school-toolbar-v5{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
 .school-toolbar-v5 .location-field,.school-toolbar-v5 .search-action{grid-column:1/-1}
 .school-row-v5{grid-template-columns:1fr auto}
 .school-row-v5 .programmes{grid-column:1}
 .school-row-v5 .days{grid-column:2;grid-row:1/3}
 .app-promo{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
 .school-toolbar-v5{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:14px}
 .school-toolbar-v5 .location-field,.school-toolbar-v5 .search-action{grid-column:auto}
 .school-row-v5{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:18px}
 .school-row-v5 .programmes,.school-row-v5 .days{grid-column:auto;grid-row:auto}
 .school-row-v5 .btn{width:100%}
 .school-results-head{display:block}
 .app-promo-copy{padding:28px}
 .app-visual{min-height:300px}
 .app-features{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* V6 final refinements */
.topbar-links{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;white-space:nowrap}
.topbar-links i{font-style:normal;color:#555c66}
.topbar-links a{color:#c9ced6;transition:color .18s ease}
.topbar-links a:hover{color:#fff}

.shop-categories-v6{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,1fr);gap:14px}
.shop-cat-v6{position:relative;isolation:isolate;min-height:154px;padding:24px;border:1px solid #2d323a;border-radius:24px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#181b21,#121419);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,background .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.shop-cat-v6:before{content:"";position:absolute;left:0;top:0;bottom:0;width:3px;background:#343a43;transition:background .2s ease}
.shop-cat-v6:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,12,16,.30),rgba(10,12,16,.88) 64%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(10,12,16,.86),rgba(10,12,16,.40)),var(--catbg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:.58;z-index:-1;transition:opacity .22s ease,transform .22s ease,filter .22s ease;filter:saturate(.92) contrast(1.02)}
.shop-cat-v6 > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
.shop-cat-v6 .shop-cat-top{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:16px}
.shop-cat-v6 .shop-cat-index{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#737b87}
.shop-cat-v6 .shop-cat-arrow{width:34px;height:34px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid #343a43;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#d9dde3;font-size:17px;transition:background .2s ease,border-color .2s ease}
.shop-cat-v6 h3{margin:22px 0 5px;font-size:24px;letter-spacing:-.025em}
.shop-cat-v6 p{margin:0;color:#8f97a2;font-size:13px}
.shop-cat-v6.active{border-color:#e2252d;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1c1b20,#171216);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(226,37,45,.18),0 18px 36px rgba(0,0,0,.2)}
.shop-cat-v6.active:before{background:#e2252d}
.shop-cat-v6.active:after{opacity:.72;filter:saturate(1.02) contrast(1.04)}
.shop-cat-v6.active .shop-cat-arrow{background:#e2252d;border-color:#e2252d;color:#fff}
.shop-products-anchor{scroll-margin-top:128px}

@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
 .shop-cat-v6:hover{transform:translateY(-4px) scale(1.015);border-color:#454c56;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
 .shop-cat-v6:hover:after{opacity:.69;transform:scale(1.03);filter:saturate(1.04) contrast(1.05)}
 .shop-cat-v6:hover:before{background:#e2252d}
 .shop-cat-v6:hover .shop-cat-arrow{border-color:#e2252d;color:#fff}
}
@media(max-width:1000px){
 .burger{position:fixed;right:18px;bottom:18px;z-index:95;width:56px;height:56px;background:#e2252d;border-color:#ff555c;box-shadow:0 14px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.44);font-size:22px}
 .mockup-note{left:14px;right:auto;bottom:18px}
 .shop-categories-v6{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}
}
@media(max-width:680px){
 .topbar{height:auto;min-height:38px;padding:7px 0}
 .topbar .wrap{align-items:center}
 .topbar .wrap>span:first-child{display:none}
 .topbar-links{width:100%;justify-content:center;gap:8px;font-size:11px}
 .shop-categories-v6{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:10px}
 .shop-cat-v6{min-height:132px;padding:18px;border-radius:20px}
 .shop-cat-v6 h3{font-size:20px;margin-top:15px}
 .shop-cat-v6 p{font-size:12px}
 .shop-cat-v6 .shop-cat-arrow{width:31px;height:31px}
}
@media(max-width:420px){
 .shop-categories-v6{grid-template-columns:1fr}
}


/* V8 generated category + values artwork */
.shop-categories-v6{gap:18px}
.shop-cat-v6{min-height:228px;padding:24px 25px;border-radius:28px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.13);background:#111318;box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.16);justify-content:space-between}
.shop-cat-v6:before{width:4px;top:22px;bottom:22px;border-radius:0 4px 4px 0;background:rgba(255,255,255,.22);z-index:2}
.shop-cat-v6:after{background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(7,9,12,.16) 0%,rgba(7,9,12,.34) 35%,rgba(7,9,12,.94) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(7,9,12,.52),rgba(7,9,12,.06)),var(--catbg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;opacity:1;filter:saturate(.92) contrast(1.08)}
.shop-cat-v6 .shop-cat-index{font-size:12px;color:rgba(255,255,255,.78);background:rgba(7,9,12,.5);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);padding:7px 9px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.1)}
.shop-cat-v6 .shop-cat-arrow{width:42px;height:42px;border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.28);background:rgba(8,10,13,.48);backdrop-filter:blur(8px);font-size:19px}
.shop-cat-v6 h3{font-size:29px;color:#fff;margin:32px 0 5px;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.6)}
.shop-cat-v6 p{color:#d1d5dc;font-size:13px;max-width:90%;text-shadow:0 2px 12px rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
.shop-cat-v6.active{border-color:#e2252d;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(226,37,45,.2),0 22px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.25)}
.shop-cat-v6.active:after{opacity:1;filter:saturate(1.03) contrast(1.08)}
.shop-cat-v6.active:before{background:#e2252d}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
 .shop-cat-v6:hover{transform:translateY(-6px) scale(1.018);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.32);box-shadow:0 24px 44px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}
 .shop-cat-v6:hover:after{opacity:1;transform:scale(1.045);filter:saturate(1.06) contrast(1.1)}
}
.value-grid{gap:20px}
.value-card{min-height:286px;padding:30px 30px 28px;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid #e3ddd6;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(11,12,14,.08);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-start;background-color:#f7f4f0;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.99) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.985) 48%,rgba(255,255,255,.93) 63%,rgba(255,255,255,.45) 79%,rgba(255,255,255,.12) 100%),var(--valuebg);background-size:cover;background-position:right center;position:relative;overflow:hidden;color:#13151a}
.value-card:before{content:'';position:absolute;left:0;top:20px;bottom:20px;width:6px;background:#e2252d;border-radius:0 8px 8px 0}
.value-card:after{content:'';position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(255,255,255,.06),rgba(255,255,255,0));pointer-events:none}
.value-card .num{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:54px;height:40px;border-radius:14px;background:#111318;color:#fff;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;margin-bottom:58px;position:relative;z-index:2}
.value-card h3,.value-card strong,.value-card p{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:54%}
.value-card h3{font-size:28px;line-height:1.02;margin:0 0 10px}
.value-card strong{font-size:16px;line-height:1.35;margin-bottom:10px;color:#21262d}
.value-card p{font-size:14px;color:#5b6470;line-height:1.62;margin:0}
@media(max-width:1180px){.shop-cat-v6{min-height:210px}.value-card{min-height:260px}.value-card h3,.value-card strong,.value-card p{max-width:58%}}
@media(max-width:700px){.shop-cat-v6{min-height:190px}.value-card{min-height:250px;padding:24px 24px 22px;background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.985) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.965) 54%,rgba(255,255,255,.74) 73%,rgba(255,255,255,.22) 100%),var(--valuebg)}.value-card .num{margin-bottom:44px}.value-card h3,.value-card strong,.value-card p{max-width:66%}}


/* V10 instructor directory + live-site coverage */
.instructor-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:end;gap:20px;margin-bottom:28px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.instructor-toolbar p{max-width:670px;margin:0;color:#9fa6b0}
.instructor-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:20px}
.instructor-card{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2b3038;box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.18);transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.instructor-photo{height:330px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#242933,#101218)}
.instructor-photo img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.instructor-photo .initials{position:absolute;inset:0;display:grid;place-items:center;font-size:70px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.07em;color:rgba(255,255,255,.8);background:radial-gradient(circle at 70% 20%,rgba(226,37,45,.30),transparent 30%),linear-gradient(145deg,#22262e,#0e1014)}
.instructor-photo .photo-label{position:absolute;left:16px;bottom:16px;padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(9,11,14,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#fff}
.instructor-copy{padding:22px 22px 24px}
.instructor-copy .role{font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#f05b63}
.instructor-copy h3{font-size:27px;line-height:1.02;margin:8px 0 8px}
.instructor-copy p{font-size:14px;color:#aeb5bf;margin:0 0 16px}
.location-chips{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:14px}
.location-chips a,.location-chips span{font-size:11px;font-weight:800;color:#e2e6ec;padding:7px 10px;border:1px solid #353b44;border-radius:999px;background:#111318}
.instructor-meta{display:grid;gap:8px;margin-top:14px;padding-top:14px;border-top:1px solid #2b3038;font-size:12px;color:#8f97a2}
.coverage-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:14px}
.coverage-card{padding:20px;border-radius:22px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2b3038}
.coverage-card b{display:block;font-size:17px;margin-bottom:5px}.coverage-card span{font-size:13px;color:#9ca4ae}
.region-school-grid{display:grid;gap:12px}
.policy-summary{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:26px;align-items:start}
.policy-points{display:grid;gap:12px}.policy-points div{padding:16px 18px;border-radius:18px;background:#171a20;border:1px solid #2b3038;color:#cbd1da}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.instructor-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.012);border-color:#414853;box-shadow:0 24px 48px rgba(0,0,0,.28)}}
@media(max-width:1100px){.instructor-grid,.coverage-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:700px){.instructor-grid,.coverage-grid,.policy-summary{grid-template-columns:1fr}.instructor-photo{height:300px}}


/* V11 polish: local brand assets, instructor directory, image-led news */
.header-inner{gap:18px}
.brand-v3{min-width:300px;max-width:330px;flex:0 0 310px}
.brand-v3 .logo-full{height:50px}
.nav{gap:15px;font-size:12px}
.nav a{white-space:nowrap}
.header-actions{gap:9px;flex:0 0 auto}
.header-actions .desktop-action{white-space:nowrap;min-width:140px;padding-left:16px;padding-right:16px}
.hero-photo-card>img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.value-card{background-image:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.98) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,.95) 35%,rgba(255,255,255,.78) 53%,rgba(255,255,255,.24) 75%,rgba(255,255,255,.04) 100%),var(--valuebg)!important;background-position:center right!important}
.value-card h3,.value-card strong,.value-card p{max-width:50%!important}
.instructor-copy p{line-height:1.65}
.instructor-photo img.fallback-animal{object-fit:cover;background:#15181d}
.instructor-card .photo-label{max-width:calc(100% - 32px)}
.news-card{isolation:isolate;background:#111318!important}
.news-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,13,.08) 0%,rgba(8,10,13,.34) 38%,rgba(8,10,13,.96) 100%),var(--newsbg);background-size:cover;background-position:center;z-index:-1;transition:transform .25s ease,filter .25s ease;filter:saturate(.93) contrast(1.06)}
.news-card>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.news-card h3,.news-card p{max-width:90%;text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.75)}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){a.news-card:hover:before{transform:scale(1.045);filter:saturate(1.03) contrast(1.08)}}
@media(max-width:1220px){.brand-v3{min-width:255px;max-width:275px;flex-basis:265px}.nav{gap:11px;font-size:11px}.header-actions .desktop-action{min-width:124px;padding-left:12px;padding-right:12px}}
@media(max-width:1000px){.brand-v3{min-width:300px;max-width:330px;flex-basis:auto}.header-actions .desktop-action{display:none}}

.instructor-photo img.fallback-animal{
  object-fit:cover;
  object-position:center 34%;
  background:#15181d;
  filter:saturate(.96) contrast(1.03);
}
.instructor-card:has(img.fallback-animal) .instructor-photo:after{
  content:"";
  position:absolute;
  inset:0;
  background:linear-gradient(180deg,transparent 58%,rgba(10,12,16,.32));
  pointer-events:none;
}


/* V14 — restore the earlier clean Train/programme tile design */
.program-card{
  border-radius:28px !important;
  overflow:hidden !important;
  background-color:#15181d !important;
  background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,8,11,.18) 0%,rgba(6,8,11,.38) 40%,rgba(6,8,11,.92) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,10,13,.62) 0%,rgba(8,10,13,.18) 58%,rgba(8,10,13,.10) 100%),var(--progbg) !important;
  background-size:cover !important;
  background-position:center !important;
  border:1px solid #2c3038 !important;
  min-height:390px !important;
  padding:28px !important;
  display:flex !important;
  flex-direction:column !important;
  justify-content:space-between !important;
  position:relative !important;
  isolation:isolate;
  transition:transform .22s ease,box-shadow .22s ease,border-color .22s ease !important;
}
.program-card:before{
  content:"" !important;
  position:absolute !important;
  width:260px !important;
  height:260px !important;
  border-radius:50% !important;
  right:-100px !important;
  top:-80px !important;
  inset:auto !important;
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(226,37,45,.24),transparent 68%) !important;
  pointer-events:none;
  z-index:0;
}
.cards-3 .program-card:nth-child(2):before{
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(232,170,58,.22),transparent 68%) !important;
}
.cards-3 .program-card:nth-child(3):before{
  background:radial-gradient(circle,rgba(70,130,255,.18),transparent 68%) !important;
}
.program-card > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
.program-card .age{
  display:inline-block !important;
  width:max-content;
  border-radius:999px !important;
  padding:7px 11px !important;
  background:rgba(13,16,22,.58) !important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px) !important;
  font-size:11px !important;
  font-weight:900 !important;
  letter-spacing:.12em !important;
}
.program-card h3{
  font-size:31px !important;
  line-height:1 !important;
  margin:20px 0 10px !important;
  text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.55) !important;
}
.program-card p{
  color:#d3d8de !important;
  max-width:92% !important;
  text-shadow:0 2px 14px rgba(0,0,0,.65) !important;
}
.program-card .arrow{
  font-size:28px !important;
  width:48px !important;
  height:48px !important;
  border-radius:999px !important;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.18) !important;
  background:rgba(10,12,16,.35) !important;
  backdrop-filter:blur(6px) !important;
  display:grid !important;
  place-items:center !important;
}
@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .program-card:hover{
    transform:translateY(-5px) scale(1.018) !important;
    box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.28) !important;
    border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.2) !important;
  }
}
@media(max-width:680px){
  .program-card{min-height:330px !important}
  .program-card:hover{transform:none !important}
}


/* V15 — venue-photo backgrounds for school/location tiles */
.venue-photo-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background-color:#121418 !important;background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,13,.14) 0%,rgba(8,10,13,.38) 42%,rgba(8,10,13,.82) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(12,14,18,.58) 0%,rgba(12,14,18,.24) 56%,rgba(12,14,18,.45) 100%),var(--schoolbg) !important;background-size:cover !important;background-position:center !important}
.venue-photo-card:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.03),rgba(255,255,255,0) 42%);pointer-events:none}
.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card{align-items:center}
.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card > *,.school-detail-map.venue-photo-card > *{position:relative;z-index:1}
.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card h3,.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card .programmes,.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card .address,.school-detail-map.venue-photo-card strong,.school-detail-map.venue-photo-card span,.school-detail-map.venue-photo-card .kicker{text-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.65)}
.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card .address{color:#d5d9df}
.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card .programmes{color:#edf0f4;max-width:46ch}
.school-row-v5.venue-photo-card .pill{background:rgba(15,18,22,.75);backdrop-filter:blur(3px)}
.school-detail-map.venue-photo-card{min-height:320px;background-position:center center !important;box-shadow:var(--shadow);border-color:rgba(255,255,255,.13)}
.school-detail-map.venue-photo-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 20px 20px 20px;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,0),rgba(255,255,255,.18),rgba(255,255,255,0));opacity:.9}


/* V19 — full-image WJO values cards */
.value-card{
  min-height:320px !important;
  padding:28px !important;
  border-radius:30px !important;
  border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15) !important;
  background-color:#14171c !important;
  background-image:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,13,.16) 0%,rgba(8,10,13,.34) 38%,rgba(8,10,13,.84) 100%),var(--valuebg) !important;
  background-size:cover !important;
  background-position:center !important;
  color:#fff !important;
  display:flex !important;
  flex-direction:column !important;
  justify-content:flex-end !important;
  box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.18) !important;
}
.value-card:before{content:"" !important;position:absolute !important;left:0 !important;top:22px !important;bottom:22px !important;width:5px !important;height:auto !important;border-radius:0 6px 6px 0 !important;background:#e2252d !important}
.value-card:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(8,10,13,.16),rgba(8,10,13,0) 58%);pointer-events:none}
.value-card .num{position:absolute !important;left:28px !important;top:26px !important;width:54px !important;height:40px !important;border-radius:14px !important;background:rgba(10,12,16,.72) !important;color:#fff !important;backdrop-filter:blur(6px);margin:0 !important;z-index:2}
.value-card h3,.value-card strong,.value-card p{position:relative;z-index:2;max-width:78% !important;text-shadow:0 2px 16px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.value-card h3{font-size:30px !important;margin:0 0 8px !important;color:#fff !important}
.value-card strong{font-size:16px !important;line-height:1.35 !important;margin-bottom:8px !important;color:#fff !important}
.value-card p{font-size:14px !important;line-height:1.55 !important;margin:0 !important;color:#d7dce3 !important}
@media(max-width:700px){.value-card{min-height:275px !important}.value-card h3,.value-card strong,.value-card p{max-width:86% !important}}

/* V19 — clickable Super J's animal meaning cards */
.animal-grid .animal{appearance:none;-webkit-appearance:none;font:inherit;color:inherit;text-align:center;cursor:pointer;position:relative;overflow:hidden;min-height:240px;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.animal-grid .animal .animal-meaning{max-height:0;opacity:0;overflow:hidden;transition:max-height .28s ease,opacity .22s ease,margin .22s ease;color:#c9cfd8;font-size:13px;line-height:1.55;margin-top:0}
.animal-grid .animal.open{justify-content:flex-start;padding-top:28px;box-shadow:0 18px 38px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.animal-grid .animal.open .animal-meaning{max-height:180px;opacity:1;margin-top:14px}
.animal-grid .animal .animal-hint{font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.14em;color:#7f8792;margin-top:10px;font-weight:800}
.animal-grid .animal.open .animal-hint{color:#b9c0ca}


/* V20 — image-backed content cards for Super J's and Teens & Adults */
.info-image-card,.adult-bg-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background-color:#11161c!important;background-image:var(--cardbg)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:var(--cardpos,center)!important;border-color:#313845!important;color:#fff!important;min-height:320px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.info-image-card::before,.adult-bg-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,14,.14) 0%,rgba(8,10,14,.30) 34%,rgba(8,10,14,.72) 68%,rgba(8,10,14,.92) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(255,255,255,.08) 0%,rgba(255,255,255,0) 42%);z-index:0}
.info-image-card::after,.adult-bg-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;height:48%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(11,14,18,0),rgba(11,14,18,.82));z-index:0}
.info-image-card>*,.adult-bg-card>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.info-image-card h3,.adult-bg-card h3{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.42)}
.info-image-card p,.adult-bg-card p{color:#dde2ea!important;text-shadow:0 1px 6px rgba(0,0,0,.45);max-width:92%}
.info-image-card .icon-circle,.adult-bg-card .icon-circle{background:rgba(124,19,28,.82)!important;color:#ff787d!important;backdrop-filter:blur(5px)}
.animal-grid .animal .animal-visual{width:94px;height:94px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;margin:0 auto 12px}
.animal-grid .animal .animal-visual img{width:88px;height:88px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:18px;filter:saturate(.15) brightness(1.03) contrast(1.05)}
.animal-grid .animal .animal-visual span{font-size:58px;filter:grayscale(1) contrast(1.2)}
.animal-grid .animal strong{font-size:22px;letter-spacing:.02em}
.animal-grid .animal.open strong{margin-top:0}
@media(max-width:680px){.info-image-card,.adult-bg-card{min-height:260px;padding:24px}.animal-grid .animal .animal-visual{width:78px;height:78px}.animal-grid .animal .animal-visual img{width:72px;height:72px}}



/* V21 – button hovers, confident kidz image cards, stronger background-card rendering, mobile timetable fix */
.kidz-bg-card,.adult-bg-card,.info-image-card{position:relative;overflow:hidden;isolation:isolate;background-color:#11161c!important;background-image:var(--cardbg)!important;background-size:cover!important;background-position:var(--cardpos,center)!important;background-repeat:no-repeat!important;border-color:#313845!important;color:#fff!important;min-height:320px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:flex-end}
.kidz-bg-card::before,.adult-bg-card::before,.info-image-card::before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(6,8,10,.10) 0%,rgba(6,8,10,.18) 24%,rgba(6,8,10,.48) 60%,rgba(6,8,10,.82) 100%),linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(0,0,0,.22) 0%,rgba(0,0,0,.10) 48%,rgba(0,0,0,.04) 100%);z-index:0}
.kidz-bg-card::after,.adult-bg-card::after,.info-image-card::after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:auto 0 0 0;height:46%;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(10,12,16,0),rgba(10,12,16,.78));z-index:0}
.kidz-bg-card>*,.adult-bg-card>*,.info-image-card>*{position:relative;z-index:1}
.kidz-bg-card h3,.adult-bg-card h3,.info-image-card h3{color:#fff!important;text-shadow:0 2px 10px rgba(0,0,0,.55)}
.kidz-bg-card p,.adult-bg-card p,.info-image-card p{color:#e2e7ee!important;text-shadow:0 1px 8px rgba(0,0,0,.48);max-width:94%}
.kidz-bg-card .icon-circle,.adult-bg-card .icon-circle,.info-image-card .icon-circle{background:rgba(118,22,31,.78)!important;color:#ff6f75!important;backdrop-filter:blur(5px);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}

@media (hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){
  .btn,.burger{transition:background-color .18s ease,color .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease,transform .18s ease,opacity .18s ease}
  .btn:hover,.burger:hover{transform:translateY(-1px)}
  .btn.red:hover{background:#ff4b53;border-color:#ff6d73;box-shadow:0 16px 34px rgba(226,37,45,.34)}
  .btn.ghost:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.08);border-color:#69727e;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
  .btn.dark:hover{background:#272c34;border-color:#454c57;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.20)}
  .btn.light:hover{background:#f1f3f6;border-color:#dde2ea;color:#111;box-shadow:0 12px 24px rgba(0,0,0,.12)}
  .burger:hover{background:#e2252d;border-color:#ff6167;color:#fff;box-shadow:0 14px 28px rgba(226,37,45,.28)}
}

@media(max-width:760px){
  .timetable,.timetable tbody{display:block;width:100%}
  .timetable tr{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:0;margin:0 0 12px;border:1px solid #2b3037;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#171a1f}
  .timetable td{display:block;background:transparent!important;border:0!important;padding:16px 18px}
  .timetable td:first-child,.timetable td:last-child{border-radius:0!important}
  .timetable td:nth-child(odd){border-right:1px solid #232932}
  .timetable td:nth-child(-n+4){border-bottom:1px solid #232932}
  .timetable td:last-child{grid-column:1/-1;padding-top:12px}
  .timetable td:last-child .btn{width:100%;min-height:42px;font-size:12px}
}

@media(max-width:680px){
  .kidz-bg-card,.adult-bg-card,.info-image-card{min-height:272px;padding:24px}
}

}

 html,body{overflow-x:hidden}

 .section-header{display:block!important}.section-header>p{margin-top:14px!important;max-width:none!important}

 .instructor-copy{padding:24px!important}.instructor-copy h3{font-size:30px!important}
 .hero-actions{flex-wrap:wrap!important}.hero-actions .btn{width:100%!important;justify-content:center!important}
 .school-row-v5{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:12px!important;padding:20px!important}.school-row-v5 .btn{width:100%!important}
 .timetable,.timetable tbody{display:block!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important}
 .timetable tr{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;margin:0 0 12px!important;border:1px solid #2b3037!important;border-radius:18px!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#171a1f!important}
 .timetable td{display:block!important;min-width:0!important;padding:15px 16px!important;border:0!important;border-bottom:1px solid #252b33!important;overflow-wrap:anywhere!important}
 .timetable td:nth-child(odd){border-right:1px solid #252b33!important}
 .timetable td:last-child{grid-column:1/-1!important;border-right:0!important;border-bottom:0!important}
 .timetable td:last-child .btn{display:flex!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;justify-content:center!important}

}

}


/* V25 — expanded safeguarding hub and policy pages */
.safeguard-hub-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:16px}
.safeguard-card{min-height:270px;padding:26px;border:1px solid #2e343d;border-radius:25px;background:linear-gradient(155deg,#1a1e25,#111318);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:space-between;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.safeguard-card .sg-icon{width:54px;height:54px;border-radius:17px;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#3a171b;color:#ff676d;font-size:24px;font-weight:900}
.safeguard-card h3{font-size:25px;line-height:1.05;margin:24px 0 10px}.safeguard-card p{color:#aeb5bf;margin:0}.safeguard-card .sg-link{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.06em;color:#fff;margin-top:24px}
.safeguard-card.external{background:linear-gradient(155deg,#25222a,#171419)}
@media(hover:hover) and (pointer:fine){.safeguard-card:hover{transform:translateY(-5px);border-color:#515866;box-shadow:0 20px 42px rgba(0,0,0,.24)}}
.safeguard-alert{border-radius:24px;padding:25px 28px;background:#3a1217;border:1px solid #702129;display:grid;grid-template-columns:auto 1fr auto;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin-bottom:26px}.safeguard-alert .alert-mark{width:50px;height:50px;border-radius:50%;display:grid;place-items:center;background:#e2252d;color:#fff;font-weight:1000;font-size:22px}.safeguard-alert b{font-size:18px}.safeguard-alert p{margin:4px 0 0;color:#e6cfd1}.safeguard-alert a{white-space:nowrap}
.safeguard-contact{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.2fr .8fr;gap:18px;margin-top:22px}.safeguard-contact>div{padding:24px;border-radius:22px;border:1px solid #303640;background:#171a20}.safeguard-contact h3{margin:4px 0 9px;font-size:23px}.safeguard-contact p{color:#aeb5bf;margin:0}.safeguard-contact a{color:#fff;text-decoration:underline;text-decoration-color:#e2252d;text-underline-offset:4px}
.policy-page{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 290px;gap:34px;align-items:start}.policy-body{display:grid;gap:18px}.policy-section{padding:28px 30px;border:1px solid #2d333c;border-radius:24px;background:#15181e}.policy-section h2{font-size:30px;line-height:1.1;margin:0 0 12px}.policy-section h3{font-size:20px;margin:22px 0 8px}.policy-section p,.policy-section li{color:#b7bdc6}.policy-section ul,.policy-section ol{padding-left:21px;margin:10px 0 0}.policy-section li+li{margin-top:7px}.policy-sidebar{position:sticky;top:128px;display:grid;gap:14px}.policy-sidebar .sidebar-card{padding:22px}.policy-sidebar a.policy-jump{display:block;padding:8px 0;color:#c9ced6;border-bottom:1px solid #292e35;font-size:14px}.policy-sidebar a.policy-jump:last-child{border-bottom:0}.policy-meta{display:flex;gap:9px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 24px}.policy-meta .pill{background:#20242b}.source-button{margin-top:14px}.principles-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px}.principle{padding:18px;border-radius:17px;background:#20242b;border:1px solid #303640}.principle b{display:block;color:#fff;margin-bottom:4px}.principle span{font-size:13px;color:#aeb5bf}.contact-list{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px}.contact-item{padding:18px;border:1px solid #303640;border-radius:17px;background:#1a1d23}.contact-item b{display:block;margin-bottom:5px}.contact-item span{display:block;color:#aeb5bf;font-size:14px}.policy-page details{border:1px solid #303640;border-radius:17px;background:#1a1d23;padding:0 18px}.policy-page summary{cursor:pointer;padding:17px 0;font-weight:800}.policy-page details>div{padding:0 0 18px;color:#b7bdc6}.parents-checks{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:10px;margin-top:18px}.parents-checks div{padding:15px 17px;border:1px solid #303640;background:#171a20;border-radius:15px;color:#d8dce2}.parents-checks div:before{content:'✓';color:#ff5a61;font-weight:1000;margin-right:9px}
@media(max-width:1050px){.safeguard-hub-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.policy-page{grid-template-columns:1fr}.policy-sidebar{position:static;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}.principles-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr)}}
@media(max-width:680px){.safeguard-hub-grid,.safeguard-contact,.contact-list,.parents-checks,.principles-grid,.policy-sidebar{grid-template-columns:1fr}.safeguard-card{min-height:230px}.safeguard-alert{grid-template-columns:auto 1fr}.safeguard-alert .btn{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%}.policy-section{padding:22px}.policy-section h2{font-size:26px}}


/* V27 — mobile footer polish + centered instructor imagery */
.footer a{transition:color .22s ease,opacity .22s ease}
.footer a:hover{color:#fff;opacity:1}
.footer-grid>div{min-width:0}

@media(max-width:760px){
  .footer{padding-top:18px}
  .footer-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:16px!important}
  .footer-grid>div{padding:20px 20px 18px;border:1px solid #252a32;border-radius:22px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#151920 0%,#101318 100%);box-shadow:0 12px 28px rgba(0,0,0,.16)}
  .footer-grid>div:first-child{padding:0 0 4px;border:0;background:transparent;box-shadow:none;border-radius:0}
  .footer-grid h4{margin:0 0 14px;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.18em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#ff6b72}
  .footer-grid a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:17px;line-height:1.35;color:#d3d8e0}
  .footer-grid a:last-child{border-bottom:0;padding-bottom:0}
  .footer-grid p{font-size:15px;line-height:1.7;margin-bottom:0}
  .footer-bottom{margin-top:18px;padding-top:16px;display:grid!important;gap:8px;text-align:left;color:#9096a0}
  .footer .brand-v3{width:100%;max-width:280px}
  .footer .brand-v3 .logo-full{height:auto;max-width:100%}

  .instructor-photo,
  .founder-photo{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;overflow:hidden}
  .instructor-photo img,
  .founder-photo img,
  .leader-card-v3 img,
  .leader-card.revised img{object-position:center center!important}
  .instructor-card:first-child .instructor-photo img{object-position:center center!important}
}

@media(max-width:480px){
  .footer-grid>div{padding:18px}
  .footer-grid a{font-size:16px}
  .instructor-photo{min-height:320px!important}
  .founder-photo{min-height:360px!important}
  .instructor-photo img,
  .founder-photo img,
  .leader-card-v3 img,
  .leader-card.revised img,
  .instructor-card:first-child .instructor-photo img{object-position:center 26%!important}
}

/* V28 — centred mobile instructor imagery + live Events list/month views */
.event-view-toolbar{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:18px;align-items:center;margin:0 0 26px;flex-wrap:wrap}
.event-view-switch{display:inline-flex;padding:5px;border:1px solid #303641;border-radius:999px;background:#12151a}
.event-view-switch button{border:0;background:transparent;color:#9fa6b0;padding:10px 18px;border-radius:999px;font-weight:900;cursor:pointer;letter-spacing:.04em}
.event-view-switch button.active{background:var(--red);color:#fff;box-shadow:0 8px 20px rgba(226,37,45,.22)}
.event-search{display:flex;gap:8px;min-width:min(100%,480px)}
.event-search .field{flex:1}
.event-list-v28{display:grid;gap:16px}
.event-row-v28{display:grid;grid-template-columns:150px 165px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:22px;align-items:center;padding:18px;border:1px solid #2c323b;border-radius:24px;background:#15191f;overflow:hidden;transition:transform .18s ease,border-color .18s ease,box-shadow .18s ease}
.event-row-v28:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);border-color:#454c57;box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.18)}
.event-thumb-v28{height:112px;border-radius:16px;background:linear-gradient(145deg,#242933,#101218);overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center}
.event-thumb-v28 img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#fff}
.event-date-v28{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:13px}
.event-date-v28 .day{font-size:46px;line-height:.9;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:-.05em}
.event-date-v28 .month{font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em;color:#f05b63;text-transform:uppercase}
.event-date-v28 .weekday{font-size:12px;color:#8f97a2;margin-top:3px}
.event-body-v28 .kicker{margin-bottom:5px}
.event-body-v28 h3{font-size:23px;line-height:1.08;margin:0 0 7px}
.event-body-v28 p{margin:0;color:#aeb5bf;font-size:14px;max-width:700px}
.event-body-v28 .venue{display:block;margin-top:8px;color:#e5e8ed;font-size:13px;font-weight:800}
.event-row-v28 .btn{white-space:nowrap}
.event-months{display:grid;gap:30px}
.event-month{border:1px solid #2b3038;border-radius:28px;background:#111419;overflow:hidden}
.event-month-head{display:flex;align-items:end;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:25px 28px;border-bottom:1px solid #292e36;background:linear-gradient(100deg,rgba(226,37,45,.12),transparent 42%)}
.event-month-head h2{font-size:38px;line-height:1;margin:5px 0 0}
.event-month-head span{font-size:13px;color:#9da4ae}
.event-calendar-scroll{overflow-x:auto;padding:0 0 4px}
.event-calendar{min-width:860px;display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(7,1fr);background:#252a32;gap:1px}
.event-weekday{background:#12151a;padding:12px 10px;text-align:center;font-size:11px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.12em;color:#9199a4;text-transform:uppercase}
.event-day-cell{min-height:144px;background:#161a20;padding:12px;position:relative}
.event-day-cell.empty{background:#101318}
.event-day-number{font-size:13px;font-weight:900;color:#8f97a2;margin-bottom:8px}
.event-day-cell.has-event{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#1d171b,#161a20)}
.month-event-link{display:block;border-radius:12px;padding:8px 9px;background:rgba(226,37,45,.13);border:1px solid rgba(226,37,45,.28);margin-top:7px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;line-height:1.3;color:#f1f3f5;transition:background .18s ease,border-color .18s ease}
.month-event-link:hover{background:rgba(226,37,45,.25);border-color:#e2252d}
.month-event-link small{display:block;color:#acb2bc;font-weight:600;margin-top:3px}
.event-view-pane[hidden]{display:none!important}
.event-source-note{margin-top:22px;padding:16px 18px;border:1px solid #2b3038;border-radius:16px;color:#8f97a2;font-size:13px;background:#111419}

@media(max-width:760px){
  /* Force every instructor image to fill the card and stay centred on phones. */
  .instructor-photo{width:100%!important;height:auto!important;min-height:0!important;aspect-ratio:1/1.08!important;display:block!important;position:relative!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#11151b!important}
  .instructor-photo img,
  .instructor-card:first-child .instructor-photo img,
  .instructor-photo img.fallback-animal{position:absolute!important;inset:0!important;width:100%!important;height:100%!important;max-width:none!important;max-height:none!important;object-fit:cover!important;object-position:50% 24%!important;margin:0!important;transform:none!important}
  .instructor-photo img.fallback-animal{object-position:50% 38%!important}
  .instructor-card{width:100%!important;margin-inline:auto!important}
  .event-view-toolbar{align-items:stretch}
  .event-view-switch{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}
  .event-view-switch button{width:100%}
  .event-search{width:100%;min-width:0}
  .event-row-v28{grid-template-columns:94px minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;padding:14px}
  .event-thumb-v28{height:88px;grid-row:1/3}
  .event-date-v28{grid-column:2;align-self:end}
  .event-date-v28 .day{font-size:34px}
  .event-body-v28{grid-column:1/-1;padding-top:4px}
  .event-body-v28 h3{font-size:21px}
  .event-row-v28>.btn{grid-column:1/-1;width:100%;margin-top:2px}
  .event-month-head{padding:20px}
  .event-month-head h2{font-size:31px}
  .event-calendar-scroll{padding-bottom:10px}
}
@media(max-width:480px){
  .instructor-photo{aspect-ratio:1/1.12!important}
  .instructor-photo img,.instructor-card:first-child .instructor-photo img{object-position:50% 22%!important}
  .event-search{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .event-search .btn{width:100%}
}


/* V29 — fully local Events + first-open Grand Master Ogden intro */
.event-row-v28{cursor:default}
.event-row-v28 .event-detail-button{white-space:nowrap}
.month-event-link{width:100%;appearance:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;font-family:inherit}
.event-source-note strong{color:#d9dde4}

.event-modal-v29{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:110;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:22px;background:rgba(3,4,6,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(14px);opacity:0;visibility:hidden;transition:opacity .25s ease,visibility .25s ease}
.event-modal-v29.open{opacity:1;visibility:visible}
.event-modal-card-v29{width:min(850px,100%);max-height:min(88vh,900px);overflow:auto;border:1px solid #343a44;border-radius:30px;background:#111419;box-shadow:0 36px 90px rgba(0,0,0,.52);transform:translateY(18px) scale(.985);transition:transform .25s ease}
.event-modal-v29.open .event-modal-card-v29{transform:none}
.event-modal-image-v29{height:290px;position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:#171b21}
.event-modal-image-v29 img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.event-modal-image-v29:after{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:linear-gradient(180deg,rgba(8,10,13,.02),rgba(8,10,13,.72))}
.event-modal-close-v29{position:absolute;z-index:3;right:18px;top:18px;width:46px;height:46px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.22);background:rgba(10,12,16,.72);color:#fff;font-size:22px;cursor:pointer;backdrop-filter:blur(8px)}
.event-modal-copy-v29{padding:30px}
.event-modal-copy-v29 h2{font-size:clamp(32px,5vw,52px);line-height:.98;margin:8px 0 18px;letter-spacing:-.04em}
.event-modal-meta-v29{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:10px;margin:22px 0}
.event-modal-meta-v29>div{border:1px solid #2a3039;border-radius:16px;padding:15px;background:#171b21}
.event-modal-meta-v29 span{display:block;color:#8f97a2;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.13em;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:5px}
.event-modal-meta-v29 b{font-size:14px;color:#eef1f5}
.event-modal-copy-v29 p{color:#b7bdc6;font-size:16px}

.wjo-intro-v29{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:9999;display:grid;place-items:center;padding:28px;background:rgba(5,6,8,.97);opacity:1;visibility:visible;transition:opacity 1s ease,visibility 1s ease}
.wjo-intro-v29.exit{opacity:0;visibility:hidden;pointer-events:none}
.wjo-intro-card-v29{width:min(900px,100%);text-align:center;padding:64px 50px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);border-radius:36px;background:radial-gradient(circle at 50% 15%,rgba(226,37,45,.14),transparent 38%),linear-gradient(160deg,#171a20,#0d0f12);box-shadow:0 42px 120px rgba(0,0,0,.52);position:relative;overflow:hidden}
.wjo-intro-card-v29:before{content:"";position:absolute;inset:0;background:repeating-linear-gradient(125deg,transparent 0 42px,rgba(255,255,255,.018) 43px 44px);pointer-events:none}
.wjo-intro-crest-v29{width:86px;height:86px;object-fit:contain;margin:0 auto 28px;opacity:0;transform:translateY(10px);animation:introPartV29 .8s .15s forwards}
.wjo-intro-quote-v29{font-size:clamp(28px,4.5vw,54px);font-weight:900;line-height:1.12;letter-spacing:-.035em;color:#f5f1ec;opacity:0;transform:translateY(16px);animation:introPartV29 1s .55s forwards}
.wjo-intro-name-v29{margin-top:28px;font-size:clamp(17px,2.2vw,24px);font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.16em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#f05b63;opacity:0;transform:translateY(14px);animation:introPartV29 .9s 2.15s forwards}
.wjo-intro-title-v29{margin-top:7px;color:#9ea5af;font-size:13px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;opacity:0;animation:introPartV29 .8s 2.65s forwards}
.wjo-intro-skip-v29{position:absolute;right:18px;top:18px;border:1px solid #343a44;background:rgba(8,10,13,.55);color:#b8bec7;border-radius:999px;padding:8px 13px;font-size:11px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
@keyframes introPartV29{to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
@media(max-width:760px){
 .event-modal-v29{padding:12px}.event-modal-card-v29{border-radius:22px}.event-modal-image-v29{height:220px}.event-modal-copy-v29{padding:22px}.event-modal-meta-v29{grid-template-columns:1fr}.event-modal-meta-v29>div{padding:12px}
 .wjo-intro-card-v29{padding:52px 24px 44px;border-radius:28px}.wjo-intro-crest-v29{width:68px;height:68px}.wjo-intro-name-v29{letter-spacing:.10em}
}
@media(prefers-reduced-motion:reduce){.wjo-intro-crest-v29,.wjo-intro-quote-v29,.wjo-intro-name-v29,.wjo-intro-title-v29{animation-duration:.01ms!important;animation-delay:.01ms!important}.wjo-intro-v29{transition-duration:.01ms!important}}



/* V30 — mobile-first basket and checkout usability */
.cart-row-v30{grid-template-columns:92px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:18px;align-items:center}
.cart-thumb-v30{width:92px;height:92px;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#fff;border:1px solid #2d3239;display:grid;place-items:center}
.cart-thumb-v30 img{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;max-width:100%;max-height:100%;object-fit:contain;object-position:center;background:#fff}
.cart-item-info{min-width:0}.cart-item-info h3{font-size:18px;line-height:1.15;margin:0 0 6px;overflow-wrap:anywhere}.cart-item-info>span{display:block;color:#9fa6b0;font-size:13px}
.cart-remove{appearance:none;border:0;background:none;color:#ff686f;padding:7px 0 0;font-size:12px;font-weight:800;cursor:pointer}
.cart-item-actions{display:grid;justify-items:end;gap:12px}.cart-item-actions>strong{font-size:18px}
.qty-stepper{display:grid;grid-template-columns:34px 36px 34px;align-items:center;border:1px solid #343a44;border-radius:999px;overflow:hidden;background:#101216}
.qty-stepper button{width:34px;height:34px;border:0;background:#1a1e24;color:#fff;font-size:19px;cursor:pointer}.qty-stepper b{text-align:center;font-size:13px}
.cart-summary-v30{align-self:start;position:sticky;top:128px}.cart-summary-v30 h3{margin:6px 0 15px}.cart-total-v30{font-size:18px;border-bottom:0!important;padding-top:16px!important}.cart-checkout-v30{width:100%;margin-top:18px;min-height:54px}
.continue-shopping-v30{display:inline-block;margin-top:16px;color:#b7bdc6;font-weight:800;font-size:13px}
.cart-empty-v30 p{color:#aeb3bc}.mobile-cart-checkout-v30{display:none}
@media(max-width:760px){
  .cart-page-v30 .page-hero{padding-bottom:28px}.cart-page-v30 .page-hero h1{font-size:clamp(42px,12vw,58px)!important}
  .cart-section-v30{padding-top:28px!important;padding-bottom:118px!important}
  .cart-layout-v30{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:20px!important}
  .cart-row-v30{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:78px minmax(0,1fr)!important;gap:13px!important;padding:13px!important;border-radius:19px!important;align-items:center!important}
  .cart-thumb-v30{grid-column:1!important;grid-row:1 / span 2!important;width:78px!important;height:78px!important;min-width:78px!important;min-height:78px!important;max-width:78px!important;max-height:78px!important;border-radius:14px!important;overflow:hidden!important}
  .cart-thumb-v30 img{width:78px!important;height:78px!important;min-width:0!important;min-height:0!important;max-width:78px!important;max-height:78px!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important}
  .cart-item-info{grid-column:2!important;grid-row:1!important;padding:0!important;min-width:0!important}.cart-item-info h3{font-size:16px!important;margin:0 0 4px!important}.cart-item-info>span{font-size:12px!important}.cart-remove{padding-top:5px!important;font-size:11px!important}
  .cart-item-actions{grid-column:2!important;grid-row:2!important;display:flex!important;justify-content:space-between!important;align-items:center!important;width:100%!important;gap:10px!important}.cart-item-actions>strong{font-size:16px!important;white-space:nowrap}
  .qty-stepper{grid-template-columns:32px 32px 32px!important}.qty-stepper button{width:32px!important;height:32px!important;min-width:32px!important;min-height:32px!important}.qty-stepper b{font-size:12px!important}
  .cart-summary-v30{position:static!important;padding:20px!important;border-radius:22px!important}.cart-summary-v30 .cart-checkout-v30{display:none!important}.summary-row{gap:16px}.summary-row span{min-width:0}.summary-row b{white-space:nowrap}.continue-shopping-v30{display:block;text-align:center;padding:4px 0 2px}
  .mobile-cart-checkout-v30{position:fixed;display:flex;left:10px;right:10px;bottom:10px;z-index:92;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;padding:10px 10px 10px 17px;background:rgba(18,20,24,.96);backdrop-filter:blur(16px);border:1px solid #343a44;border-radius:20px;box-shadow:0 18px 46px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}
  .mobile-cart-checkout-v30>div{display:grid;line-height:1.1}.mobile-cart-checkout-v30 small{color:#9ea5af;font-size:10px;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.08em}.mobile-cart-checkout-v30 strong{font-size:18px;margin-top:4px}.mobile-cart-checkout-v30>a{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;min-height:48px;padding:0 18px;border-radius:999px;background:#e2252d;color:#fff;font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.04em;white-space:nowrap;box-shadow:0 9px 24px rgba(226,37,45,.28)}
}
@media(max-width:380px){.cart-row-v30{grid-template-columns:68px minmax(0,1fr)!important;padding:11px!important}.cart-thumb-v30,.cart-thumb-v30 img{width:68px!important;height:68px!important;min-width:68px!important;min-height:68px!important;max-width:68px!important;max-height:68px!important}.cart-item-info h3{font-size:15px!important}.mobile-cart-checkout-v30>a{padding:0 14px}}



/* V31 final mobile cart safeguard */
@media(max-width:760px){
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-row-v31{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:84px minmax(0,1fr)!important;grid-template-rows:auto auto!important;gap:10px 13px!important;min-height:0!important;padding:13px!important;overflow:hidden!important}
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-thumb-v31{grid-column:1!important;grid-row:1 / span 2!important;width:84px!important;height:84px!important;min-width:84px!important;min-height:84px!important;max-width:84px!important;max-height:84px!important;padding:0!important;margin:0!important;border-radius:14px!important;overflow:hidden!important;background:#fff!important}
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-thumb-v31 img{display:block!important;width:84px!important;height:84px!important;min-width:84px!important;min-height:84px!important;max-width:84px!important;max-height:84px!important;object-fit:contain!important;object-position:center!important;margin:0!important;padding:0!important;position:static!important;transform:none!important}
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-item-info{grid-column:2!important;grid-row:1!important;min-width:0!important}
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-item-actions{grid-column:2!important;grid-row:2!important;display:flex!important;align-items:center!important;justify-content:space-between!important;min-width:0!important}
  .cart-page-v31 .summary{max-width:100%!important;overflow:hidden!important}
}
@media(max-width:390px){
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-row-v31{grid-template-columns:72px minmax(0,1fr)!important}
  .cart-page-v31 .cart-thumb-v31,.cart-page-v31 .cart-thumb-v31 img{width:72px!important;height:72px!important;min-width:72px!important;min-height:72px!important;max-width:72px!important;max-height:72px!important}
}

/* --- V32 updates: centred mobile logo, floating mobile menu, social links, front-end admin mockups --- */
.social-row{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:10px;margin-top:20px}.social-link{display:inline-flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;gap:8px;height:44px;padding:0 14px;border-radius:999px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.12);background:#11151b;color:#fff;font-weight:800;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.04em}.social-link svg{width:16px;height:16px;fill:currentColor}.social-link:hover{border-color:#e2252d;box-shadow:0 12px 30px rgba(226,37,45,.18)}
.footer-brand-copy{color:#858b94;max-width:360px;margin-top:18px}
.admin-login-wrap{padding:56px 0 80px}.admin-login-card{width:min(560px,100%);margin:0 auto;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:linear-gradient(180deg,#181c23,#101216);border-radius:28px;box-shadow:var(--shadow);padding:32px}.admin-login-card h2{font-size:42px;line-height:.98;margin:10px 0 14px}.admin-login-card p{color:#adb3bc}.admin-demo-credentials{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:12px;margin:18px 0;padding:14px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.admin-demo-credentials div{font-size:13px;color:#d7dbe2}.admin-demo-credentials b{display:block;color:#fff;font-size:12px;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:4px}.admin-form-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:14px;margin-top:18px}.admin-form-grid .field,.admin-demo-panel .field{width:100%;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #2d3440;background:#0d1117;color:#fff;padding:14px 16px;min-height:50px}.admin-form-grid .wide{grid-column:1/-1}.admin-mini-note{margin-top:12px;font-size:12px;color:#8f96a1}

.admin-two-col{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1.1fr .9fr;gap:18px}.admin-demo-panel .field, .admin-demo-panel textarea, .admin-demo-panel select{width:100%;border-radius:16px;border:1px solid #2a313c;background:#0d1117;color:#fff;padding:14px 16px;min-height:50px}.admin-demo-panel textarea{min-height:130px;resize:vertical}.form-stack{display:grid;gap:12px}.helper-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:12px}.helper-card{padding:16px;border-radius:18px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.04);border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06)}.helper-card b{display:block;margin-bottom:5px}.helper-card span{display:block;color:#aab1bb;font-size:14px}.mini-copy{font-size:13px;color:#9aa2ac}.admin-shortcuts{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,1fr);gap:14px}.admin-shortcut{display:block;padding:18px;border-radius:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.06);background:#10151c}.admin-shortcut b{display:block;font-size:19px}.admin-shortcut span{display:block;color:#9da5b0;margin-top:6px;font-size:14px}.admin-shortcut:hover{border-color:#e2252d}

/* ===== V39: phone-first policy + admin responsiveness ===== */
.policy-page,.policy-body,.policy-section,.policy-sidebar,.legal-callout-v38{min-width:0;max-width:100%}
.policy-section h1,.policy-section h2,.policy-section h3,.policy-section p,.policy-section li,.legal-callout-v38{overflow-wrap:anywhere;word-break:normal}
.policy-section table{max-width:100%}

@media(max-width:720px){
  /* Privacy / Cookie / Data Protection */
  .page-section>.wrap{min-width:0}
  .policy-page{display:block!important;width:100%;max-width:100%;overflow:hidden}
  .policy-body{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr);gap:14px;width:100%;max-width:100%}
  .policy-section{width:100%;max-width:100%;padding:19px 17px!important;border-radius:19px!important;overflow:hidden}
  .policy-section h2{font-size:clamp(21px,6.2vw,26px)!important;line-height:1.13!important;letter-spacing:-.025em;margin-bottom:12px!important}
  .policy-section h3{font-size:18px!important;line-height:1.2}
  .policy-section p,.policy-section li{font-size:15px!important;line-height:1.58!important}
  .policy-section ul,.policy-section ol{padding-left:20px!important;margin-left:0!important}
  .policy-section li{padding-left:1px}
  .policy-meta{margin-bottom:16px!important}
  .principles-grid,.parents-checks,.contact-list{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
  .principle,.parents-checks>div,.contact-item{min-width:0;padding:15px!important}
  .policy-sidebar{display:block!important;position:static!important;width:100%;margin-top:15px;padding-bottom:104px}
  .policy-sidebar .sidebar-card{padding:18px!important;border-radius:19px!important}
  .policy-sidebar .btn{width:100%}
  .legal-callout-v38{padding:16px!important;margin:0 0 16px!important;font-size:14px;line-height:1.5}

  /* Turn legal tables into vertically readable cards instead of wide tables */
  .retention-table-v38,.cookie-table-v38,.retention-table-v38 tbody,.cookie-table-v38 tbody,.retention-table-v38 tr,.cookie-table-v38 tr,.retention-table-v38 td,.cookie-table-v38 td{display:block!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important}
  .retention-table-v38 thead,.cookie-table-v38 thead{position:absolute!important;width:1px!important;height:1px!important;overflow:hidden!important;clip:rect(0 0 0 0)!important;white-space:nowrap!important}
  .retention-table-v38,.cookie-table-v38{margin-top:12px!important;border-collapse:separate!important}
  .retention-table-v38 tr,.cookie-table-v38 tr{margin:0 0 12px!important;padding:13px 14px!important;border:1px solid #303640!important;border-radius:16px!important;background:#1a1d23!important;overflow:hidden}
  .retention-table-v38 td,.cookie-table-v38 td{padding:7px 0!important;border:0!important;color:#b7bdc6!important;font-size:14px!important;line-height:1.5!important}
  .retention-table-v38 td:first-child,.cookie-table-v38 td:first-child{font-size:15px!important;color:#fff!important;padding-top:0!important}
  .retention-table-v38 td:last-child,.cookie-table-v38 td:last-child{padding-bottom:0!important}
  .retention-table-v38 td:nth-child(2):before{content:'Approach';display:block;color:#ff6a70;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
  .retention-table-v38 td:nth-child(3):before{content:'System action';display:block;color:#ff6a70;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
  .cookie-table-v38 td:nth-child(2):before{content:'Purpose';display:block;color:#ff6a70;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
  .cookie-table-v38 td:nth-child(3):before{content:'Default';display:block;color:#ff6a70;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}
  .cookie-table-v38 td:nth-child(4):before{content:'Examples';display:block;color:#ff6a70;font-size:10px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.13em;text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:3px}

  /* Cookie consent UI */
  .cookie-banner-v38{left:10px!important;right:10px!important;bottom:88px!important;padding:15px!important;border-radius:17px!important;gap:13px!important}
  .cookie-banner-v38 h3{font-size:17px!important}.cookie-banner-v38 p{font-size:12.5px!important;line-height:1.45}
  .cookie-actions-v38{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important;width:100%;gap:7px!important}
  .cookie-actions-v38 button{width:100%!important;min-height:44px!important}

  .cookie-panel-v38 h2{font-size:23px!important}.cookie-option-v38{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto!important;gap:10px!important}
  .cookie-modal-actions-v38{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.cookie-modal-actions-v38 button{width:100%!important}

  /* Floating front-end menu: smaller and keep legal content clear */

  main:has(.policy-page),main:has(.legal-callout-v38){padding-bottom:82px}

  /* Production admin becomes an actual mobile app layout */

  .prod-admin-brand{min-width:0;gap:8px!important}.prod-admin-brand img{width:42px!important;height:42px!important;flex:0 0 42px}.prod-admin-brand>div{min-width:0}.prod-admin-brand strong{font-size:14px!important;white-space:nowrap}.prod-admin-brand span{font-size:10px!important;white-space:nowrap}

  .prod-admin-shell{display:block!important;min-height:0!important;width:100%;max-width:100%}

  .prod-admin-user{display:none!important}.prod-admin-section-label{display:block!important;margin:8px 3px 6px!important;font-size:9px!important}
  .prod-admin-nav{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))!important;gap:6px!important;min-width:0!important;width:100%!important}

  .prod-admin-nav .nav-dot{flex:0 0 7px;width:7px!important;height:7px!important}
  .prod-admin-main{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important;padding:17px 12px 40px!important;overflow:hidden}
  .prod-admin-breadcrumb{font-size:11px!important;overflow:hidden;white-space:nowrap;text-overflow:ellipsis}
  .prod-admin-titlebar{display:block!important;margin-bottom:15px!important;min-width:0}
