  .prod-admin-page-actions{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr!important;margin-top:12px!important;width:100%}.prod-admin-page-actions a,.prod-admin-page-actions button{width:100%!important;text-align:center}
  .prod-admin-app .admin-module-grid,.prod-admin-app .admin-kpis,.prod-admin-app .admin-two-col,.prod-admin-app .admin-shortcuts,.prod-admin-app .helper-grid,.prod-admin-app .admin-meta-grid,.prod-admin-app .media-library-grid{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}
  .prod-admin-app .admin-panel,.prod-admin-app .admin-demo-panel,.prod-admin-app .admin-module-card,.prod-admin-app .admin-kpi,.prod-admin-app .admin-metabox,.prod-admin-app .helper-card,.prod-admin-app .admin-shortcut{min-width:0!important;width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;padding:16px!important;border-radius:17px!important}
  .prod-admin-app .admin-panel-head{display:block!important}.prod-admin-app .admin-panel-head h3{font-size:22px!important}.prod-admin-app .admin-panel-head .admin-actions-row{margin-top:12px!important}
  .prod-admin-app .admin-actions-row{width:100%;display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important;gap:7px!important}.prod-admin-app .admin-actions-row>*{width:100%!important;text-align:center;justify-content:center}
  .prod-admin-app .admin-table-wrap{width:100%!important;max-width:100%!important;overflow-x:auto!important;-webkit-overflow-scrolling:touch;border-radius:14px!important}
  .prod-admin-app .admin-table{min-width:680px!important;font-size:12px!important}.prod-admin-app .admin-table th,.prod-admin-app .admin-table td{padding:10px!important}
  .prod-admin-app .calendar-month-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.prod-admin-app .calendar-cell{min-height:auto!important}.prod-admin-app .week-board{grid-template-columns:1fr!important}
  .prod-admin-app .form-stack,.prod-admin-app .admin-form-grid{min-width:0}.prod-admin-app input,.prod-admin-app select,.prod-admin-app textarea{max-width:100%!important;min-width:0!important}
  .prod-admin-login{padding:14px!important;align-items:start!important}.prod-login-card{padding:22px 17px!important;border-radius:18px!important;margin-top:18px}.prod-login-logo img{width:78px!important;height:78px!important}.prod-login-card h1{font-size:25px!important}
}

@media(max-width:390px){

}

solid p{margin:0;color:#b9c0ca;font-size:14px;line-height:1.55}.newsletter-form-v40{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:9px;margin-top:16px}.newsletter-form-v40 /* ======================= V42 FIXES + FUNCTIONAL MEDIA CRUD ======================= */
.news-card.cms-clickable-news{cursor:pointer;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease}
.news-card.cms-clickable-news:hover,.news-card.cms-clickable-news:focus-visible{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#555d69;box-shadow:0 20px 45px rgba(0,0,0,.28);outline:none}
.event-row-v28.cms-clickable-event{cursor:pointer;transition:border-color .2s ease,transform .2s ease}
.event-row-v28.cms-clickable-event:hover,.event-row-v28.cms-clickable-event:focus-visible{border-color:#515966;transform:translateY(-2px);outline:none}
.cms-detail-modal{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10050;background:rgba(3,5,8,.82);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:22px}

.cms-detail-image{width:100%;max-height:340px;object-fit:cover;display:block;background:#0c1015}
.cms-detail-copy{padding:28px}.cms-detail-copy h2{font-size:clamp(30px,5vw,48px);line-height:1;margin:8px 0 14px}.cms-detail-copy p{color:#c1c7d0}.cms-detail-meta{display:flex;gap:8px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 18px}.cms-detail-meta span{padding:7px 10px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.07);font-size:12px;color:#dfe4ea}
.cms-detail-close{position:absolute;right:14px;top:14px;z-index:2;width:42px;height:42px;border-radius:50%;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.15);background:rgba(8,10,13,.88);color:#fff;font-size:24px;cursor:pointer}
.cms-event-thumb-v42{width:150px;min-width:150px;align-self:stretch;border-radius:18px;overflow:hidden;background:#0d1117}.cms-event-thumb-v42 img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:126px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.cms-school-image{height:180px;margin:-22px -22px 18px;overflow:hidden;border-radius:24px 24px 0 0;background:#0c1015}.cms-school-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.cms-record-v42{display:grid;grid-template-columns:64px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:14px;align-items:center}.cms-record-thumb{width:64px;height:64px;border-radius:15px;overflow:hidden;background:#0d1117;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);display:grid;place-items:center;color:#747e8b;font-weight:900;font-size:11px}.cms-record-thumb img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.cms-media-field{display:grid;gap:10px}.cms-media-picker-row{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;flex-wrap:wrap}.cms-media-form-preview{width:118px;height:86px;border-radius:16px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid #303844;background:#0c1015;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#858e99;font-size:12px}.cms-media-form-preview img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover}.cms-media-hidden{display:none!important}
.v42-media-top{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:14px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:18px}.v42-media-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}.v42-media-card{border-radius:22px;overflow:hidden;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:#12171e}.v42-media-image{aspect-ratio:4/3;background:#0c1015;overflow:hidden;display:grid;place-items:center;color:#717b87}.v42-media-image img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;display:block}.v42-media-copy{padding:14px}.v42-media-copy h4{font-size:15px;margin:0 0 4px;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}.v42-media-copy p{font-size:12px;color:#939ca7;margin:0 0 10px}.v42-media-actions{display:flex;gap:7px;flex-wrap:wrap}.v42-media-actions button{border:1px solid #343c48;background:#171d25;color:#fff;border-radius:999px;padding:7px 10px;font-weight:800;font-size:11px;cursor:pointer}.v42-media-actions .danger{border-color:rgba(226,37,45,.4);color:#ff8d93}
.v42-media-editor{display:grid;grid-template-columns:.85fr 1.15fr;gap:18px;margin-top:18px}.v42-media-editor-preview{border-radius:24px;overflow:hidden;min-height:300px;background:#0c1015;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);display:grid;place-items:center}.v42-media-editor-preview img{width:100%;height:100%;max-height:440px;object-fit:contain}.v42-media-editor-form{padding:20px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:#12171e;border-radius:24px}.v42-media-editor-form label{display:grid;gap:6px;margin-bottom:12px;font-size:13px;color:#b9c0c9}.v42-media-editor-form input,.v42-media-editor-form select,.v42-media-editor-form textarea{width:100%;border-radius:14px;border:1px solid #303844;background:#0d1117;color:#fff;padding:12px 14px}.v42-media-editor-form textarea{min-height:92px;resize:vertical}
.v42-media-picker{position:fixed;inset:0;z-index:10060;background:rgba(3,5,8,.84);backdrop-filter:blur(10px);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:20px}.v42-media-picker-card{width:min(920px,100%);max-height:calc(100vh - 40px);overflow:auto;border-radius:28px;background:#11161d;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.11);box-shadow:0 30px 80px rgba(0,0,0,.5)}.v42-media-picker-head{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:12px;padding:18px 20px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);position:sticky;top:0;background:#11161d;z-index:2}.v42-media-picker-head h3{margin:0}.v42-media-picker-body{padding:20px}.v42-picker-grid{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr));gap:12px}.v42-picker-item{border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);background:#171c23;border-radius:18px;padding:8px;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;color:#fff}.v42-picker-item:hover{border-color:#e2252d}.v42-picker-item img{width:100%;aspect-ratio:1/1;object-fit:cover;border-radius:12px;background:#0b0e13}.v42-picker-item b{display:block;font-size:12px;margin-top:8px;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis;white-space:nowrap}.v42-picker-upload{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-bottom:16px;padding-bottom:16px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08)}
.motion-card-inner img{width:100%;max-width:520px;height:auto;display:block;object-fit:contain}
@media(max-width:900px){.v42-media-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.v42-media-editor{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v42-picker-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.cms-event-thumb-v42{width:110px;min-width:110px}}
@media(max-width:620px){.v42-media-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}.v42-picker-grid{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr))}.cms-record-v42{grid-template-columns:54px minmax(0,1fr)}.cms-record-v42 .cms-record-actions{grid-column:1/-1}.cms-record-thumb{width:54px;height:54px}.cms-event-thumb-v42{width:100%;min-width:0;height:180px;align-self:auto}.event-row-v28.cms-clickable-event{display:grid!important;grid-template-columns:1fr!important}.cms-detail-copy{padding:22px}.cms-detail-modal{padding:12px}.cms-media-form-preview{width:96px;height:76px}}
/* ======================= END V42 FIXES ======================= */


/* ======================= V43 — restore deep links ======================= */
.cms-school-card-link{display:block;color:inherit;text-decoration:none;border-radius:22px;outline:none}
.cms-school-card-link .cms-school-card{height:100%;transition:transform .2s ease,border-color .2s ease,box-shadow .2s ease;cursor:pointer}
.cms-school-card-link:hover .cms-school-card,.cms-school-card-link:focus-visible .cms-school-card{transform:translateY(-3px);border-color:#e2252d;box-shadow:0 18px 34px rgba(0,0,0,.22)}
.cms-school-view{display:inline-flex;margin-top:14px;font-size:12px;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#ff767c}
.v43-school-hero-image{border-radius:28px;overflow:hidden;min-height:320px;border:1px solid #2b3037;background:#11161d;box-shadow:var(--shadow)}
.v43-school-hero-image img{width:100%;height:100%;min-height:320px;object-fit:cover;display:block}
.v43-article-wrap{width:min(920px,calc(100% - 44px));margin:0 auto}
.v43-article-cover{width:100%;max-height:480px;object-fit:cover;border-radius:30px;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);box-shadow:var(--shadow);margin-bottom:28px}
.v43-article-meta{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin:0 0 22px}.v43-article-meta span{padding:7px 11px;border-radius:999px;background:#171c23;border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,.08);color:#c8ced7;font-size:12px;font-weight:800}
.v43-article-body{font-size:18px;line-height:1.85;color:#d1d6de}.v43-article-body p{margin:0 0 24px}.v43-article-body p:first-child{font-size:12px;font-weight:1000;letter-spacing:.08em;color:#fff}.v43-article-actions{display:flex;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:34px}
.cms-clickable-news{cursor:pointer}
